Order.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initializes a restaurant ordering system instance by setting up an empty menu list, an empty selected-dishes list, and an empty sales dictionary to hold inventory, active order selections, and aggregated sales data respectively." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize self.menu to an empty list; this list will later hold dish records where each record is a dict with keys 'dish' (string), 'price' (numeric), and 'count' (integer representing available inventory or order quantity) RESULT self.menu]
            [COMMAND Initialize self.selected_dishes to an empty list; this list will later hold user-selected dish records where each record is a dict with keys 'dish' (string), 'count' (integer representing user-selected quantity), and 'price' (numeric) RESULT self.selected_dishes]
            [COMMAND Initialize self.sales to an empty dict; this dict will later accumulate sales data keyed by dish name or session identifier, supporting aggregated revenue or order-count lookups RESULT self.sales]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Order.add_dish:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Attempts to add a dish to the selected dishes list by finding it in the menu and decrementing its available count by the requested quantity, returning False immediately if stock is insufficient." add_dish]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "The instance containing the menu list and selected_dishes list"
        <REF> dish </REF>: dict "A dictionary with at least a 'dish' key (name) and a 'count' key (requested quantity)"
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: bool "False if the matching menu item has a count strictly less than the requested dish count; True after successfully appending the dish to selected_dishes"
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Iterate over each item in self.menu, binding the current item to menu_dish RESULT menu_dish]
            [COMMAND Within the for loop, check whether dish['dish'] equals menu_dish['dish'] to determine if the current menu item matches the requested dish by name RESULT name_match]
            [COMMAND Within the for loop, when name_match is True, check whether menu_dish['count'] is strictly less than dish['count'] to determine if available stock is insufficient RESULT stock_insufficient]
            [COMMAND Within the for loop, when name_match is True and stock is not insufficient (menu_dish['count'] >= dish['count']), decrement menu_dish['count'] by dish['count'] in place, then break out of the loop RESULT updated_menu_dish_count]
            [COMMAND After the for loop completes (either via break or full iteration), append dish to self.selected_dishes RESULT updated_selected_dishes]
            [COMMAND Return True to signal that the dish was successfully added RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: Within the for loop, name_match is True and menu_dish['count'] is strictly less than dish['count'] (stock insufficient)]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return False immediately, exiting the method without appending to selected_dishes RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Order.calculate_total:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Iterates over each selected dish and accumulates a weighted total price by multiplying each dish's unit price by its count and its corresponding sales multiplier." calculate_total]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self.selected_dishes </REF>: list "List of dish objects, each containing at minimum a 'dish' key (name), a 'price' key (unit price), and a 'count' key (quantity selected)"
        <REF> self.sales </REF>: dict "Mapping from dish name string to a numeric sales multiplier applied to the base price"
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> total </REF>: number "The accumulated sum of (price * count * sales_multiplier) for every dish in selected_dishes; returns 0 if selected_dishes is empty"
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize local variable total to the integer value 0 RESULT total]
            [COMMAND For each dish object in self.selected_dishes, retrieve dish['price'], dish['count'], and self.sales[dish['dish']], multiply all three together, and add the product to total RESULT total]
            [COMMAND Return total RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Order.checkout:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Validates that at least one dish has been selected, computes the order total from the current selection, clears the selection, and returns the total." checkout]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: number | boolean "Returns False if no dishes are selected; otherwise returns the computed total from calculate_total()"
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Get the count of items in self.selected_dishes RESULT selected_dishes_count]
            [COMMAND Call self.calculate_total() and store the return value in total RESULT total]
            [COMMAND Reset self.selected_dishes to an empty list (length 0, no elements), permanently discarding all current dish references RESULT self.selected_dishes]
            [COMMAND Return total RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: selected_dishes_count equals 0 (self.selected_dishes is empty at the time of the check)]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return False immediately, skipping total computation and list reset RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
